raw_evidence.context: The Student Funding Office are here to help answer queries regarding the Kent Financial Support Package (KFSP) or the additional student funds . They are available Monday-Friday from 10.00-16.00 via telephone and email. Phone lines are closed for lunch 12:30 until 13:30pm. Virtual appointments are available on Tuesdays and Fridays. Email: studentfunding@kent.ac.uk

raw_evidence.name: Federal Direct
raw_evidence.context: The Foreign Loans Office are here to help you if you are applying for US Federal Direct loans (using FAFSA), US Private loans, US Veterans Educational (GI Bill) Benefits, and Segal AmeriCorps Education Awards . They can also answer queries relating to other foreign government loans, i.e. Canadian Student Loans. Information on US Loans . Information on Canadian Loans
The Insurance Office can help with any queries around insurance , including travel insurance for students studying or working abroad. Email : insurance@kent.ac.uk
